draft.subject: Bonds are 23.0% of your portfolio against a 25–50% range
draft.english:
Dear [[FIRST_NAME]],

Ahead of your next review, there is one small thing I would like to raise. Under the Balanced approach we agreed for your portfolio, bonds are meant to be between 25% and 50% of it, with 35% as the aim. Today they are 23.0%, which is 2.0 points below the lower end.

It is not a loss and nothing has gone wrong; the portfolio is simply carrying a little less of the steady income you asked for than the shape you signed up to. As this is an advisory portfolio, the decision is yours.

What I would suggest is that we either bring the bond portion back into range, or you tell me you are comfortable as it is and I record that on your file. Both are fine; leaving it undecided is not.

Could I call you before the review to talk it through?
